title: Bokselskap
notes: Bokselskap (Det norske språk- og litteraturselskap, with the National Library of Norway) publishes Norwegian texts online. A CC0 TEI P5 dump of about 380 texts, dated 19 January 2023, is available from Språkbanken (National Library of Norway); the site now lists more books and offers no XML download itself. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: The National Library of Norway Sprakbanken record for the downloadable bokselskap.no 2023 corpus (TEI, about 380 texts) gives "Lisens: CC Zero (fri bruk)" for its downloadable corpus. The website itself (hjelp_om/om_bokselskap) is stricter: material may be used freely for private non-commercial purposes, other use by written agreement, and editors keep rights in introductions and philological editions.
